candidate_findings.finding_label: Unexplained location shift between adjacent scenes
candidate_findings.claim: The narrator appears in the harbor at the end of scene A but opens scene B inside the manor without a transition bridging the two locations.

evidence_spans.span_text: She lingered at the harbor wall as the tide drew back.
By morning she was already pacing the manor library.

candidate_findings.uncertainty_note: It is unclear whether an intervening scene was intended to carry the travel between harbor and manor.
candidate_findings.review_note: Reviewer should check whether the missing transition is deliberate compression or an omission.
